newsitem.title: USA: MedPlus Inc sees Q4 loss, sets buyback. [CORRECTED 19:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: MedPlus Inc sees Q4 loss, sets buyback. [CORRECTED 19:15 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects company name in headline to "MedPlus Inc" from "MedPlus Corp")
MedPlus Inc said Tuesday it expects to report a loss for the fourth quarter.
It said results would be hurt by longer-than-anticipated sales cycles for its ChartMaxx Electronic Patient Record System, which will result in lower-than-forecast revenues for the product.
The First Call consensus estimate for the company's fourth quarter earnings was not available.
MedPlus also said its board had approved the repurchase of up to 500,000 shares, to be held as treasury stock and used for general corporate purposes.
